inputs: multiple-choice questions with injected reasoning hints (6 categories)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training methodology and architecture predict faithfulness better than model scale
hypotheses.result: Confirmed - family and training method are stronger predictors than parameter count

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models suppress hint acknowledgment in outputs despite internal recognition
